//: Emit only the ppv-cli binary and its shared React-free core. The Ink binaries (pptop, ppex) and their ui/ tree are produced by esbuild (scripts/build-ink.mjs), so compiling them here too would double-compile, leave dead dist/ui|pptop|ppex artifacts, and (via sourceMap) drop stale .map files next to the esbuild bundles. Full-tree type checking still runs via `tsc --noEmit` on tsconfig.json.
